seo_title: Thomson Medical Case Study: Content for Parents | SOMIN
description: SOMIN read Thomson Medical and 6 competitors on content for Singapore parents and families, then built 6 pillars, 44 propositions and a 79-post calendar.
h1: Thomson Medical can own family moments the category still isn't publishing
lede: SOMIN read 12 months of organic content for Singapore parents and families from Thomson Medical and 6 competitors, including Mount Elizabeth, Gleneagles and KKH, and checked each trend against the prior year.
meta_line: A SOMIN brand briefing · Aug 2025 to Jul 2026 · Singapore Parents & Families

challenge.title: Where Thomson Medical can stand out against 6 Singapore hospitals
challenge.body: The audience is parents, mostly mothers aged 25 to 45, from pregnancy to school age. Which rising themes, beyond the competitor baseline, does no one own?

approach.title: 12 monthly windows checked against 4 prior-year quarterly cuts
points: Mapped Thomson Medical's portfolio, from obstetrics, fertility and paediatrics to the 24-Hour Urgent Care Centre.
Checked trends so a late spike never reads as a confident trend.
Sorted themes into whitespace, partial, emerging and brand-owned by cohort share.
Built a persona-to-proposition chain for each of 6 pillars.

findings_title: Open, rising and already-owned themes in family health content

findings.title: Family togetherness is open ground
findings.body: It is 0% for Thomson Medical and competitors, yet such content drew 1,865,612 engagements across 85 of 270 evidence posts.

findings.title: New-parenthood anxiety is a verified rise
findings.body: It rose from 0 to 26.5 items per window, peaking at 35 in January 2026, and was absent from all 4 prior-year cuts.

findings.title: Health awareness is already owned
findings.body: Health Awareness & Early-Detection Gaps is 25.3% of Thomson Medical's content against competitors' 13.5%, so it was left off the shortlist.

delivered.title: Thomson Medical's 6 pillars, 44 propositions and 79-post calendar
points: 6 pillars ranked by whitespace and trend strength
44 propositions on real reasons to believe, such as maternity and paediatric care since 1979
3 posts a week with 5 lead posts, from 11 August 2026
216 creative expressions, 12 flagged as potential top performers

quote.text: True connection blooms not in perfection, but in shared imperfections.

outcome.title: Lead with family togetherness and parental mental load
outcome.body: Family Togetherness & Milestone-Making and Parental Mental Load & Modern-Family Pressure stayed high all 12 months. Test emerging pillars while they are cheap to claim; each rests on a real asset, such as a 45+ year family health legacy.

faq.a: Mount Alvernia, Mount Elizabeth, Gleneagles, Raffles Medical Group, KKH and NUHS.
A theme qualifies only if the category is moving toward it, Thomson Medical is absent and the brand has real-world permission to lead.
